clearedSpotChecks.check: battery.py (99,985 vectors) and targeted.py (85,544 vectors) on the networks.json endpoints for 137, 56 and 43114: MULMOD with modulus 2^256-1 and full width moduli, ADDMOD, DIV, SDIV, MOD, SMOD, SIGNEXTEND, SAR, SHL, SHR, BYTE, EXP, the comparisons and the library sequences all return the specified word.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I ran 20 edge vectors of my own on 2026-11-27 as eth_call of init code with no recipient on https://polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com, https://bsc-dataseed1.bnbchain.org and https://api.avax.network/ext/bc/C/rpc: MULMOD(2^256-1, 2^256-1, 2^256-1), MULMOD(2^256-2, 2^256-2, 2^256-1), MULMOD(2^255, 2, 2^256-1), ADDMOD at full width, SDIV(-2^255, -1), SMOD(-2^255, -1), SAR by 255 and 256 of -2^255, SHL by 256, SHR by 255, BYTE 31 and 32, SIGNEXTEND 30, EXP(2, 255) and EXP(0, 0), SLT and SGT at the sign boundary, DIV and MOD by zero. Every network returned the specified word. My first run flagged ADDMOD(2^256-1, 2, 2^256-2) on all three, but the error was in my expected value: (2^256-1) mod (2^256-2) is 1, so the answer is 3, which is what all three returned. These are the operations behind src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24, :48, :112, src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:252, src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:20-26 and src/libraries/BitMath.sol:22, :45. The check agrees with the unit's battery logs.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Transient storage lifetime and slot read order in bor v2.11.2 ParallelStateDB: each transaction gets a new transient store in Prepare (parallel_statedb.go:1277-1279) and a recycled worker clears it (line 272).
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xPolygon/bor/v2.11.2/core/state/parallel_statedb.go. Line 272 is clear(s.transientStorage) inside the recycle routine, next to clears of local storage, code, balances and destructed sets. Prepare at lines 1277-1279 assigns a new access list and s.transientStorage = newTransientStorage() for every transaction. The lock flag and the nonzero delta count therefore start empty in each transaction on the parallel path, which is what src/libraries/Lock.sol:13-25 and the count check at the end of unlock rely on. I did not reread the MVStore read order (lines 332-349, 967-1034); that half of the item stays a source reading by the unit, and L-1254 remains open for the run it asks for.
